identification.title: SNODAS Snow Data Assimilation System Data Products (NSIDC G02158) (consolidated for NHF)
identification.abstract: NOAA NOHRSC SNODAS daily snow products distributed by NSIDC (collection G02158). Daily 1 km CONUS analysis combining satellite observations, ground stations, and an energy-balance snow model. Used as one source for the SWE calibration target. These data were consolidated to CF-1.6 NetCDF as part of the USGS National Hydrologic Model calibration-targets workflow.
identification.purpose: Document and distribute the consolidated form of the SNODAS Snow Data Assimilation System Data Products (NSIDC G02158) dataset as used in the USGS National Hydrologic Model workflow.
identification.rights:
None. Users are advised to read the dataset's metadata thoroughly to understand appropriate use and data limitations.

These data are distributed by the NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center (NSIDC DAAC).
